A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same wrapped Gaussian model for SPD matrices and retain Sections 1–7 and Appendices A–K. Text and rendered-page inspection support comparison of the equations, proofs, four figures and two tables.

before.justification: v3 reports original synthetic parameter-estimation experiments in Section 5.2 and Appendix J, and classification results on eight real datasets in Section 6.4 and Table 2.

after.justification: v4 retains the original synthetic parameter-estimation experiments and eight-dataset classification results, including Figures 3–4 and Table 2.

M1.justification: The wrapped Gaussian construction, sampling algorithm, maximum-likelihood estimation procedure, and homogeneous and heterogeneous WDA classifiers are unchanged.

E1.justification: The same synthetic scenarios and eight real datasets are retained. Appendix K removes 'two' from the BreizhCrops class description, but Table 1 already specifies six classes in both versions; this corrects wording rather than establishing changed task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 2 compares the same MDM, TS-LDA and TS-QDA baselines against Ho-WDA and He-WDA. Methods discussed only in related work do not become evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the synthetic sample range of 100–10,000 and dimensions 2, 5 and 10. Classification retains diagonal covariance models, cross-subject BCI evaluation, five-fold evaluation for other datasets, and the same preprocessing and metrics.

E4.justification: Figure 3 retains the sample-size and dimensionality analysis. Appendix J and Figure 4 retain the same comparison of full versus diagonal covariance estimation at dimension 10; no new ablation or robustness analysis appears.

E5.justification: Appendices I–J retain five repetitions with randomly generated true parameters. The shaded plots and Table 2's ± reporting remain unchanged, with no added run information or statistical procedure.

E6.justification: All Table 2 accuracies and accompanying ± values are unchanged, including Ho-WDA's 54.66 ± 0.45 on BreizhCrops. Figures 3–4 retain the same curves and findings; Figure 3's label adjustment does not alter results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, density and Jacobian formulas, wrapped CLT, equivalence results and appendix proofs are retained. Changed cross-reference labels and equation formatting do not revise the mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: a non-isotropic wrapped Gaussian, its theoretical properties and estimation framework, and probabilistic classification on SPD matrices. The claims about performance with sufficient samples are unchanged.

C2.justification: The expanded Impact statement adds possible assistive-technology benefits from BCI classification and discusses behavioral profiling and privacy/consent risks. This extends v3's brief discussion of brain understanding and marketing/manipulation; scientific interpretations and computational limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 adds explicit bibliography links to MOABB, the PyRiemann archive and the Indiana Pines dataset. The paper's own code link, implementation details, preprocessing and optimizer limits are retained; the change concerns documented access.

R1.justification: The cited research and positioning are retained. Sanborn et al. (2024) becomes Papillon et al. (2025), but both references identify 'Beyond Euclid'; this is a publication and authorship-metadata update rather than a new cited work.

P1.justification: The Impact statement is rewritten, the BreizhCrops wording is corrected, and citation/header conventions change. Section order and most prose remain intact. Several cross-references now inaccurately call retained definitions and propositions 'Theorem', including Definition 4.13 and Proposition 5.1.

P2.justification: The main text and bibliography switch to an ICML two-column layout, with resized figures, regrouped tables and extensive reflow; appendices are also reformatted. All four figures and two tables remain. Figure 3 moves the misplaced star to the covariance symbol in its right-panel title.

improvement.justification: The method, proofs, experimental support and conclusions remain unchanged. Corrected BreizhCrops wording, the repaired Figure 3 label and added resource links offer small usability gains, while new 'Theorem' cross-reference mislabeling reduces precision. The expanded Impact statement and extensive reformatting leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
